the genetic determinism of fatty acids in palm oil is complex, but that the expression of genes involved in fatty acid metabolism is under the control of few key transcription factors, and that the expression of these genes is under the control and influence of a limited number of genes.

the genetic basis for the high oleic acid trait in oil palm is the combination of the following: a) a strong genetic control, b) a high heritability, and c) the existence of a major QTL on linkage group 1, which explains 50% of the variation.

oil palm is a promising source of genes for the improvement of oil crops and that oil palm fatty acids can be modified by genetic engineering.
